notes: Two English *whose*es counted against one אֲשֶׁר and two suffixes; the fusion reading (relative + first suffix, second suffix taking the second *whose*) is taken with the rule 55 alternative named in the unit note.
The distributive לְ pair gives the single written *after* to the second preposition, which stands before the second *piece*, and leaves the first unrepresented under rule 22.
*take out of it* keeps the phrasal particle and the object-reaching *of* with the verb (rule 44), with the suffix taking *it*.
